what_happened: Confirmed via live BimodalLogic evidence (heartbeat-trace.log, git log) that heartbeat silence for tasks 696/649 is a design gap: 11 of 13 domain *-implementation-agent.md files never call update-phase-status.sh, bypassing the mechanized heartbeat entirely via direct Edit-tool phase-heading mutation. Only general-implementation-agent.md was migrated.

Piece 1's full remediation (migrating ~11 domain *-implementation-agent.md files to call update-phase-status.sh) likely exceeds this task's file_scope (agent-system/extensions/core/ only) since those agent files live in other extensions (lean, typst, latex, etc). Plan must make an explicit scope decision rather than silently widening or dropping the fix.

The dead-session-registry-entries item (ALSO OBSERVED note) is already correctly handled: skill-refresh/SKILL.md already calls task-lock.sh session-reap on explicit /refresh invocation. No code change needed; dropped from plan scope, saving implementation effort.

Piece 1's file_scope tension (13 un-migrated agent files across 12 other extensions) was resolved without widening scope: orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh and orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh are per-dispatch, agent-prose-independent heartbeat sites inside core, and lint-agent-contracts.sh's Check G already carries the curated 14-agent in-scope set the regression lint can reuse.

test-four-tier-conflict.sh Case 6 (budget-bound, 1000ms budget) fails under current machine load (~3000ms elapsed) both against the pristine HEAD task-lock.sh and the Phase 4 held-live modified version -- confirmed pre-existing, load-dependent, unrelated to this task's cmd_check changes. Likely caused by concurrent sibling /orchestrate dispatches (tasks 366, 271, 306) on this same machine per this dispatch's territory block.

Phases 4 and 6's new test fixtures used literal 'task NNN' phrasing for fictional fixture project numbers (810, 811, 813), tripping check-task-references.sh outside specs/**. Fixed by rewording to 'project NNN' / 'fixture project NNN' in scripts/test-session-registry.sh and scripts/tests/test-task-lock-liveness.sh; re-ran check-task-references.sh (0 occurrences) and both affected suites (13/13, 15/15) after the fix.
